name: Remedy Aura
notes: Cut from HoH1: Remedy's level 4 carries a commented-out friendly aura (range 60, refreshed every 0.25 s) that gave allies a 1 s 'remedy' buff of 5 health regen per second; the buff is commented out of players/buffs.sval too. HoH1 shipped Remedy as a self-only healing bonus.
summary: Remedy also heals the party: allies within 60 of you regenerate 5 health per second.
